programmes.d: A wild gang of robots rampage through the city; Uran tries to teach Jump how to do tricks; disguising himself as a dog, Astro sneaks out to search for the Robot Vikings.
Vivian's plane is brought down, and she loses her memory when Astro saves her; ice at the North Pole melts and floods world cities.
Astro receives a message in a bottle from captives held in an undersea mining station and heads off to rescue them, but first he must tangle with an ocean monster.
Strange snow drains energy from everything it touches; Astro battles a leopard.
Residents believe their village at the foot of a mountain will be ruined when the human-faced rock on top turns its direction.
Uran sneaks into the venue for the Robotics Championships, takes part in a match and defeats a player, but Daddy Walrus refuses when the promoter scouts for her.
Ikki and Koji each want to be team leader.
When Metabee's medal goes missing, the gang suspects that Team France has stolen it.
Samantha unravels as she prepares for a ballet recital while training for her next match.
Ikki falls under the spell of a championship girls' team from Sweden.
Ikki learns the origins of the Days of Darkness from Joe Swihan.
The Ancient One helps the heroes reach Talpa's castle and the team faces the combined might of the dark forces in an attempt to break through and face Talpa himself.
Talpa easily defeats Ryo and integrates his warlords' armors into his own form, directly attacking the heroes to steal their armors for himself.
With the powers of all the other armors at his command, Talpa confronts Ryo, the only remaining warrior, who must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.

As Ryo fights to keep Talpa from absorbing him into his armor, the Ancient One tells Ryo about Talpa's origins and helps Ryo understand the armors can be used for good as long as the heroes stay determined to fight against evil.

Despite vanquishing Talpa and restoring the city and its people, the heroes remain unsettled due to the lingering evil forces and the toll the Inferno Armor is taking on Ryo; a new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the armor for himself.

Saranbo gathers forces to prepare to go after Ryo's armor; full of regret and not wanting his friends to get hurt in his defense, a weakened Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.

programmes.d: Nadia and Jean come up with a plan to escape the island.

programmes.d: After their friend Marie gets abducted by invaders, Jean and Nadia infiltrate a secret base in the center of the island to try and rescue her; they discover the base's ownership by an organization who call themselves Neo Atlantis.

programmes.d: During a rescue attempt, Nadia is kidnapped.
Conan is captured; Lana, Dyce, and Jimsy navigate Industria's underground barracks and learn more about life during Lepka's rule.
Conan rushes to stop Lepka from flooding the underground community while Lana contemplates how she can help save the residents.
Lepka attempts to escape with his hostage Lana in tow, but Conan won't give up on his friend.
As earthquakes rattle Industria, its residents fear that another cataclysm will occur; Lepka seeks to revive the massive warplane, Gigant, to make the world his own.
As Lepka attacks, Conan infiltrates Gigant to try and stop him.
The people of High Harbor rejoice as Dyce and Jimsy are finally rescued.
The Knight Sabers are hired to rescue a little girl from a group of kidnappers, but the girl is far more than she seems.
Linna's friend threatens to expose Genom's secrets that led to the death of her fiancé, but Genom plans to silence her.
The Knight Sabers attack Genom Tower to put an end to Genom executive Brian J. Mason's schemes.
A racer modifies his car into a weapon of vengeance against the biker gangs of Megatokyo, but the car soon develops a mind of its own.
A killer is draining victims of their blood, but it is no vampire; a pair of escaped love-doll androids, Priss' new friend Sylvie and the D.D. super-weapon have something to do with it.
A group of fake Knight Sabers are ruining the group's reputation, leading to a fight against a returning foe.
Gubila damages the pipeline, causing the dock to flood.
Choichiro Hikari, a member of the monster fighting team Scientific Defense Guard, joins forces with Ultraman Jonias to save Earth from looming danger.
A strange red cloud appears; it begins to rain, and the red cloud transforms into a monster and begins a rampage.
Several thousand trees disappear from the forest in a single night; in an underground cave they find Toughgilas.
As people evacuate from a tsunami caused by an earthquake in the Pacific Ocean, a mysterious flying object appears and rains down fire.
Pig, ESDS's robot, fears he may be replaced by a newer model; but he is the only one who can sense the imminent attack by a monster hidden underground.
Ultraman's battle with a monster is caught on film and sent to a TV station; Hikari fears it may reveal Ultraman's true identity.
Astro is sent to Outer Spaceport R45 by Dr. Elephant to clean up space pirates.
